subject.title: [Feature]: Add X-Actual-Model header to expose runtime model in HTTP responses

question: What actual-runtime-model metadata contract should Gateway expose for non-streaming and streaming OpenAI-compatible HTTP responses?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but normal response headers cannot cover late fallback selection after SSE headers flush, so implementation needs maintainer intent on the public API shape.

options.title: Define unified HTTP/SSE metadata
options.body: Document and implement one actual-model contract for Chat Completions and Responses across non-streaming body/header metadata and streaming SSE-compatible metadata.

options.title: Limit first pass to non-streaming
options.body: Add actual-model response metadata only where it is known before headers are sent and leave streaming attribution as an explicit follow-up limitation.

options.title: Defer to broader runtime metadata
options.body: Keep transport response attribution deferred until the broader resolved-model and session-status metadata contract is decided.

recommendation.title: Define unified HTTP/SSE metadata
recommendation.body: Document and implement one actual-model contract for Chat Completions and Responses across non-streaming body/header metadata and streaming SSE-compatible metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this exact Gateway HTTP contract gap and has the strongest recent Gateway HTTP/docs history signal among likely owners.
